# Native block dominance ownership

The compiler-bound Witness owner test reports three direct native dominance
calls and zero Primitive relation calls before adoption. Witness policy must
use the canonical gotoolchain capability from Primitive's compiled catalog.

The query borrows two actual blocks in one native function and returns the
existing SSARelationObservation. It validates parent/program/package and actual
native slot membership, delegates the relation to Go, and preserves final
context refusal with no proof beside an error. It retains no block population
and does not convert structural dominance into runtime reachability.

Behavioral proof exhausts all sixteen relations in a source-level diamond and
all sixty-four endpoint/custody/context combinations. The semantic oracle uses
the source diamond's meaning, not the queried method. Separate hostile rows
cover absent, parentless, foreign, detached, negative and at-extent loans;
constant arms, lexical functions and loop backedges challenge Go control facts.
The producer LayerTriad proves positive dominance, an actual custody refusal,
and neutral siblings without inspecting an unrelated damaged root.

Ten native mutations must fail assertions, not compilation or panic: invent,
erase or reverse the relation; ignore either endpoint's custody; admit a foreign
program; weaken the cross-frame contract; discard final cancellation; retain a
function population; and substitute runtime reachability. Restore only their
selected controls. Allocation probes at 32 and 8193 branches require zero query
bytes; compiler construction is excluded. Benchmark and semantic fuzz campaigns
use the user's three-second development settings after final tools.

Unrelated OAuth work is in progress in the shared checkout. Proof uses an
immutable git-archive source tree at the recorded committed base plus only the
owned additions. Retain the failed dependency build and fixture setup
failure. The malformed finite-domain fixture was repaired and retried alone;
passing fuzz seeds were not repeated as a repair. Source snapshots, native
commands, overlays, failures, successful output and hashes move with the entire
idle Mac scratch, caches included, to Furnace's HDD warehouse.

This is development proof of the named capability and handoff. It does not issue
independent acceptance or claim that the whole Witness migration is complete.
